scope: owned native desktop fixtures; private paths and captures excluded

scenarios: preview without writes and pinned initial installation
activation keeps the existing fixture daemon responsive
changed preview payload and active generation are refused
compatible rollback switches all commands and retains both releases
tampered executable is refused without changing activation
cleanup retains active, rollback and running or legacy binaries
uninstall preserves the live daemon and its state
daemon exit releases its pin and invalidates stale cleanup preview
unused payloads removed; permanent pins and daemon state retained
packaged_maintenance.generations: same binaries with synthetic metadata; not distinct-source upgrade acceptance

graphical_failure.error: native window did not reach readiness and complete a screenshot

tcp_observation.method: lsof polling through window exit; short-lived sockets between samples may be missed

instrumented_graphical_run.source_change: bounded renderer diagnostics and viewport readiness fields only

limitations: The original graphical timeout remains unresolved; an instrumented pass does not establish its cause.
Renderer source consumes screenshot commands before acquiring the surface; a skipped surface can lose capture. This is a diagnostic lead requiring a controlled reproduction.
No public signing/notarization, native Windows, distinct-source update or live daemon transfer acceptance.
Raw logs and window captures remain private.
